title: Download 990 Efile Data
text: code pulls four tables one year, keeps fields needed, merges single data frame ready get_features(). run (downloads full-year tables); mirrors data-raw/make-dat-example.R, builds bundled dat_example. resulting dat_govern can passed straight get_features(); see vignette("governance-workflow").
code: library(data.table) library(dplyr)  ROOT <- "https://nccs-efile.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/public/efile_v2_1/" YEAR <- 2022  get_table <- function(table.name, select) {   options(timeout = max(600, getOption("timeout")))   fread(paste0(ROOT, table.name, "-", YEAR, ".CSV"),         colClasses = "character", select = select) }  id <- c("OBJECTID", "ORG_EIN")  p06 <- get_table("F9-P06-T00-GOVERNANCE",                  c(id, "RETURN_TYPE",                    "F9_06_GVRN_NUM_VOTING_MEMB", "F9_06_GVRN_NUM_VOTING_MEMB_IND",                    "F9_06_GVRN_DTK_FAMBIZ_RELATION_X", "F9_06_GVRN_DELEGATE_MGMT_DUTY_X",                    "F9_06_GVRN_DOC_GVRN_BODY_X", "F9_06_POLICY_FORM990_GVRN_BODY_X",                    "F9_06_POLICY_COI_X", "F9_06_POLICY_COI_DISCLOSURE_X",                    "F9_06_POLICY_COI_MONITOR_X", "F9_06_POLICY_WHSTLBLWR_X",                    "F9_06_POLICY_DOC_RETENTION_X", "F9_06_POLICY_COMP_PROCESS_CEO_X",                    "F9_06_DISCLOSURE_AVBL_OTH_X", "F9_06_DISCLOSURE_AVBL_OTH_WEB_X",                    "F9_06_DISCLOSURE_AVBL_REQUEST_X", "F9_06_DISCLOSURE_AVBL_OWN_WEB_X"))  p04 <- get_table("F9-P04-T00-REQUIRED-SCHEDULES",                  c("OBJECTID",                    "F9_04_AFS_IND_X", "F9_04_BIZ_TRANSAC_DTK_X",                    "F9_04_BIZ_TRANSAC_DTK_FAM_X", "F9_04_BIZ_TRANSAC_DTK_ENTITY_X",                    "F9_04_CONTR_NONCSH_MT_25K_X", "F9_04_CONTR_ART_HIST_X"))  p12 <- get_table("F9-P12-T00-FINANCIAL-REPORTING",                  c("OBJECTID",                    "F9_12_FINSTAT_METHOD_ACC_OTH", "F9_12_FINSTAT_METHOD_ACC_ACCRU_X",                    "F9_12_FINSTAT_METHOD_ACC_CASH_X"))  m01 <- get_table("SM-P01-T00-NONCASH-CONTRIBUTIONS",                  c("OBJECTID", "SM_01_REVIEW_PROCESS_UNUSUAL_X"))  # OBJECTID is unique per filing. Parts IV/VI/XII are core 990 parts (inner join); # Schedule M is filed by only some orgs (left join). Drop EZ filers, who lack # these fields. dat_govern <- p06 |>   merge(p04, by = "OBJECTID") |>   merge(p12, by = "OBJECTID") |>   merge(m01, by = "OBJECTID", all.x = TRUE) |>   filter(RETURN_TYPE != "990EZ")

title: Making Governance Scores
text: Scores calculated DC−1LDC^{-1}L, LL calculated fa function using polychoric correlations. Thus, want scores S=DCpolychoric−1LS = DC^{-1}_{polychoric}L. However, even specify fa function use polychoric correlations calculating LL, always use Pearson correlations calculating scores. Thus scores object fa output always Sdefault=DCPearson−1LS_{default} = DC^{-1}_{Pearson}L. Since interested polychoric correlations, need calculate scores using factor.scores function control correlation matrix used.
code: ## Default scores  S.defult <- model6$scores  ## Pearson Corelation C.pearson <- cor(features2)  ## Polychoric Correlation C.poly <- rho2  ## What we want  S.poly <- D %*% solve(C.poly) %*% L # show that ||S.polychoric - factor.scores output|| ~= 0 sum(abs(scores$scores - S.poly)) #approx 0 #> [1] 2.529046e-10  ## What the `fa` funciton gives us S.pearson <- D %*% solve(C.pearson) %*% L # show that ||S.default - fa output|| ~=0  sum(abs(S.defult - S.pearson)) #approx 0 #> [1] 1.315959e-10  #But S.poly =/= S.pearson sum(abs(S.defult - S.poly)) #> [1] 161480.6
